item.title: In line with WHO framework, T.N.’s National Centre of Ageing provides integrated care for the elderly
item.description: WHO’s approach is to provide a continuum of integrated care that helps to reorient health and social services towards more person-centred and coordinated care

item.title: Three men arrested for illegal sand mining from Palar riverbed in Vellore
item.description: According to the police, the gang reportedly confessed that the sand was mined from dry riverbed to sell the consignment to retail traders.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Health Minister Arunraj inaugurates Centre for Advanced Genomics at Ranipet CMC
item.description: Health officials said that the new facility is aimed to provide high-end genetic testing and will enable rapid, accurate diagnosis of many conditions that include complex cancers, rare inherited disorders, infectious diseases and susceptibility to lifestyle diseases.

item.title: Illegal sand mining in Tamil Nadu: Duraimurugan and other accused were aware of environmental impact, says DVAC
item.description: FIR accuses former DMK Minister, officials and contractors of the Water Resources Department of conspiring to cheat the government.
